name: gedit
blurb: gedit is an easy-to-use and general-purpose text editor.
description:
gedit is an easy-to-use and general-purpose text editor. Its development
started in 1998, at the beginnings of the GNOME project, with a good
integration with that desktop environment.

You can use it to write simple notes and documents, or you can enable more
advanced features that are useful for software development.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
